body:
FOR THE APP PARTS 2 AND 4 (code read 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a). Parts 1, 1b and the server half of 4 are on main; the drawing is merged (#146).

STATE OF THE CLAIM. The claim "Now: the raw keep error ... then app parts 2 and 4" is stale on its first half: that fix is on main as #149 (2278460, squash-merged; the branch task/keep-reason-words-for-members still shows one commit "ahead" because of the squash, its content is in main). Do not redo it. `GET refs/{id}/keep` and `PUT saved-albums` now send reasons by role (api.py:625-642, keeper/failures.py). No app code reads `keep/progress`, `keep/watch` or `keep/retry` yet (grep: none), so all of part 2 and 4 is app work.

WHERE THINGS PLUG IN
 * Live event: data/encore/encore_live.dart:252 forwards `(type, map)`; the consumer is `_liveEvents` in app/session.dart:537 (a `switch` on the type, `hello`/`library.changed`/`resync` today). Add `keep.progress` there; the news feed does the same for `notification.new` (features/news/news_providers.dart:72) and is the pattern to copy.
 * `PUT keep/watch` needs a caller with a device id (api.py:705, "Only a signed-in device"). The app's REST calls still carry the music-server login plus the `X-Encore-Device` header, which the legacy door accepts as the device (B-5/B-55), so it works today and keeps working when P3-03 gives each phone a token. Say what is watched again on every reconnect: the reply is the current answer (docs/17).
 * Waiting for the server is not stored. `DownloadManager._waitingForServer` (download_manager.dart:113) is a per-pass set; a row stays `queued`. Part 2 needs a query for "queued and `tracks.file_id IS NULL`" in DownloadsRepository (none exists) or the server's `keep.progress` counts, not the manager's set.
 * Retry: `DownloadManager.retryFailed()` (download_manager.dart:478) only re-queues rows on the phone. Part 4 calls `POST keep/retry {kind,id}` first for the songs the server failed, then reconciles. Phone-side failures (disk, transfer, verify) are a different cause: `downloads.last_error` holds raw text (`'$error'`, download_manager.dart:367,389) and no screen shows it today, so the words for "the phone's reason wins" (S-16) must be written, not read from there.

OPEN DECISION (B-62, decide when part 2 is built): the app never calls `POST refs/{sr}/keep`, and `promote` is only reached from that route, a saved release and `keep/retry`. So Download on a playlist or on Liked Songs promotes nothing: its songs wait in the background keep queue (priority 4, behind every other person's, B-39), although docs/17 says "a download asks for a song to be kept first in line". Options: a batched promote for the pinned groups (a new call; `keep/watch` must NOT do it, its contract says asking changes nothing) or correct docs/17's row. State which in the PR.

FOR THE HOST (note of 5 Nov 06:54): a keep that waits for its own reason (full disk) shows as `queued`; the Host sees "waiting its turn" for ever. Keep that in the drawing of P3-13.

TESTS: server tests/test_keep_progress.py, test_keep_watch.py, test_keep_retry.py exist; the app has none. Walk: tools/journeys/ui.py on two emulators, 200-song playlist, stop the server mid-way.
